description: Figure 16b illustrates the relationship between initial confidence and accuracy for the MMLU dataset, plotted with three distinct lines representing final accuracy (blue line with triangle markers), delta accuracy (orange line with diamond markers), and initial accuracy (green line with circle markers). The x-axis, labeled "Initial Confidence," spans a range from approximately 0.86 to 1.00 in linear scale, with tick labels appearing at intervals of 0.01. The y-axis, labeled "Accuracy," ranges from 0.0 to 1.0 in linear scale, with major gridlines and tick marks at intervals of 0.2. The blue line, representing final accuracy, remains consistently high, hovering near 1.0 across the entire confidence range. The green line, representing initial accuracy, shows a steady upward trend from approximately 0.6 at an initial confidence of 0.86 to nearly 1.0 at an initial confidence of 1.0. The orange line, representing delta accuracy, exhibits significant fluctuations, starting at approximately 0.2, dipping to near 0.0 at an initial confidence of 0.91, and then rising again to approximately 0.2 at an initial confidence of 1.0.
